reading.body:
Greenidge is a converted power plant in Yates County that has operated as a cryptocurrency mining and data center facility. The company is real, publicly documented, and survived a reverse takeover restructuring in 2021, but this site has not located published specifications for the facility's power capacity, IT load, or current operational status. Research is marked exhausted with no additional sourcing available this session.

New York has 31 mapped data center facilities, of which only one publishes a megawatt figure to this site. Greenidge ranks second in the state by published capacity, which means it publishes no figure and therefore claims zero megawatts on record here. The state total of published capacity is 3 MW, concentrated in a single facility.

Whether this campus matters to AI scaling cannot be determined from published specifications. The facility's power capacity, conversion timeline, current idle or operational status, and grid interconnection are not published. Any assessment of its relevance to AI infrastructure requires direct operator disclosure of these facts.
